title: Merge Policy Controller and protection validation
description: Implement frozen implementation-order Item 6: deterministic merge eligibility, protected-main validation, artifact-bound HIGH-risk Human Gate enforcement, required CI enforcement, hourly protection-drift validation, and deterministic post-bootstrap merge execution.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Gate evidence is stored outside repository artifact bytes as structured PR comments and must reference the exact current artifact_hash. HUMAN evidence must be authored by the configured Project Owner login.

acceptance_criteria.description: Merge eligibility is computed deterministically from revalidated risk, scope, artifact hash, review, verification, security where required, Human Gate, branch protection, required CI and lock validity.
HIGH-risk merge eligibility fails closed unless Human Approval is valid and bound to the exact current artifact hash.

Protection validation fails closed if active main protection, no-bypass policy, deletion/non-fast-forward protection, pull-request enforcement, strict required checks, or exact required GitHub Actions contexts cannot be verified.
F-4 is satisfied by a dedicated GitHub-required status check named merge-policy; HIGH Human Gate therefore cannot be bypassed by GitHub's static approval count.
Any out-of-scope changed path fails closed; documentation and semantically trivial changes are not exempt.
Reviewer PASS, Security PASS for HIGH tasks, lock evidence and Human Approval are artifact-bound; any artifact change invalidates stale evidence.
Protection Drift Monitor runs pre-merge and at least hourly through scheduled CI; missing live protection blocks policy validation.
After Item 6 is canonical, workflow_dispatch merge execution revalidates the exact PR head, all merge-policy inputs and required CI before calling the GitHub merge API.
No forbidden path is modified by the implementation PR and existing verification gates are not removed or weakened.

bootstrap_constraint.rule: Item 6 must execute its dedicated merge-policy check on its own exact artifact and that check must be added to the protected-main required contexts before the task becomes merge-eligible. Because the deterministic workflow_dispatch merge executor does not exist on canonical main until this task merges, the final merge of Item 6 itself uses one explicit and final bootstrap exception only after exact-artifact Review PASS, Verification PASS, Security PASS, Owner Human Approval, active protection evidence, merge-policy required-check enforcement and zero scope violations.
